description: EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program (GHGRP) reported emissions for one facility by year, from EPA Envirofacts (CO2e summed across gases per year, as published). Uses the GHGRP facility id (e.g. 1000001). Facility search and sector breakdowns are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
